verdict.rationale: Missive documents a command bar (⌘/Ctrl+K) supporting search, snooze, and other quick commands, plus configurable swipe/keyboard shortcuts, which is direct evidence of keyboard-driven command palette functionality. However, there's no comprehensive shortcut list, no dedicated performance benchmarks, and community comments call the UI 'unintuitive' with 'design flaws' though also 'snappy' — mixed signal on speed/polish. Missing for 10: a full documented shortcut reference covering all major actions, explicit performance/latency claims, and independent hands-on confirmation of speed and keyboard completeness.
